messages:
maria: Morning — launching Redwood Optimize GA next week. Quick sync: SLA wording, docs, oncall staffing, monitoring playbooks, pricing thresholds. I put a quick checklist here, need owners. @sam @kevin @anya @oliver
sam: Logged. Can we confirm latency SLOs and error budgets? current target is p95 < 120ms for hosted; dedicated 60ms. Are those final?
kevin: Those are proposed. Engineering needs a contingency plan if queues spike — suggested fallback to lower-capacity model and circuit-breaker. I'll add a runbook snippet.
kevin: snippet:
```
if qlen > 500:
  route -> model-quantized-2
  alert -> eng-oncall
```
anya: Docs: I have draft user-facing SLA page but need legal-approved wording for "uptime" and "scheduled maintenance" windows. If legal doesn't sign off by Fri, we can publish with "subject to contract" note.
oliver: Sales needs a clear pricing uplift for SLA-backed Dedicated. Proposed +20% for SLA package. Need docs showing cost/latency tradeoffs for customers.
maria: Owners: SLA wording (anya + legal), runbooks (kevin), oncall coverage (sam), pricing write-up (oliver). Does that map?
sam: Oncall: current SRE rota covers nights M-F, but weekends only on-call on call-elect. We need an escalation path for P0s. @anya can you add a "who to page" table?
anya: Yep. I'll add table and link to internal runbook. Also will include short "How to interpret logs" section and example alerts.
kevin: Monitoring: add synthetic tests for critical endpoints + token-level latency histogram. We should have alert thresholds at p95>150ms and error rate >1% over 5m.
maria: OK, can we list blockers? Anything that will block GA?
sam: Blocker: legal SLA signoff. Also need SLO burn rate calc integrated into console metrics (frontend). Workaround: surface raw latency + simple alerting.
oliver: From sales: blocker is missing pricing examples for top 3 verticals (SaaS, EComm, Regulated). I can draft templates by Thu.
anya: Docs blocker: screenshots for Console UI needed (new staging build). @kevin can you produce a staging env snapshot?
kevin: Will spin staging and take screenshots by end of day.
maria: Timeline: final signoffs by Fri EOD. Owners please confirm in this thread with ✅ when done.
sam: ✅
kevin: ✅
anya: Will add docs + screenshots, aiming Thu. ✅ (if staging ready)
oliver: Drafting pricing templates, will drop in #sales by Thu. ✅
release-bot: Deploy scheduled: staging build for screenshots -> 2026-09-04 16:00 UTC. CI result: green.
maria: Great — I'll compile final checklist and send to PM execs. Thanks everyone :pray:
